ModMetaData.name: RimTaxi
ModMetaData.author: KUSH
ModMetaData.description:
RimTaxi — civilian taxi shuttle for RimWorld.
Call a taxi from the comms console, pay silver, and transport colonists and limited cargo to a world-map destination.
Uses the vanilla TransportShip pipeline. Does not require Odyssey. Royalty is not required (this mod ships its own ship/world defs).
Hospitality integration is not included.
Graphics: custom yellow taxi shuttle texture (top-down).
